worklog.py.name: CSV work-log interaction
worklog.py.description: Creates the entries CSV, appends timestamped tasks, scans rows for date/minutes/name matches and pages results. Minutes matching is substring-based. Regex search mistakenly invokes findall on the input string instead of the compiled pattern. Edit/delete are stubs.

README.md.name: Course goals versus implementation
README.md.description: Lists desired work-log features; code implements CSV entry/search but does not implement the promised editing, deletion or date-range search.
